props.title: Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver
props.lede: If you’re planning an event at Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver, you’ve probably seen the rooftop already. It’s an awesome indoor-outdoor bar on the top floor, looking out over the buildings downtown, and live music sounds great up there.

headingText.html: Tejas Singh played the rooftop bar and patio as a duo for a corporate conference reception hosted by Softdocs.

props.title: Live music in each Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver event space
props.lede: Here’s the act we’d pick for each space. Press play to hear it over the photo.

spaces.name: Rooftop bar and patio
spaces.facts: The rooftop is an indoor-outdoor performance space with a bar, on the top floor. Huge folding glass doors open the indoor side to the patio, and the act can set up in a spot that covers both sides, wherever guests are standing. The hotel lists its Rooftop Terrace at about 1,260 sq ft, for up to 78 guests.
spaces.why: Tejas played the rooftop as a duo for a corporate conference reception.
spaces.alt: Lounge chairs around the rooftop fireplace, with a glass rail and city towers beyond.

spaces.name: Lobby
spaces.facts: The lobby is cozy, and it’s at street level.
spaces.why: One guitarist playing blues, jazz and Spanish flavors, soft enough to keep talking.
spaces.alt: The lobby bar with a long wood counter and a blue tile wall.

spaces.name: Colorado Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Colorado Ballroom is on the top floor, with about 2,530 sq ft for up to 300 guests. It divides into three smaller spaces: Breckenridge (up to 120 guests), Aspen (up to 100) and Vail (up to 80).
spaces.why: A six-piece band playing 90s and 2000s R&B and hip-hop, for when you want everyone dancing.
spaces.alt: The Colorado Ballroom set with round tables, with windows on two sides.

spaces.name: Apple Blossom and the Hospitality Suite
spaces.facts: Apple Blossom, the hotel’s farm-to-table restaurant, offers the restaurant and its terrace (about 5,000 sq ft together) for weddings and gatherings. The hotel also has a Hospitality Suite with its own outdoor terrace.
spaces.why: Upright bass and guitar, at a volume nobody has to raise their voice over.
spaces.alt: The Hospitality Suite with a long wood dining table, a kitchenette and a sitting area.

props.title: Planning music at Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver

rows.text: The act unloads in the alley, and load-in is through the main elevator.
Our act brought its own sound system, so the hotel didn’t need to provide any AV support. The rooftop bar also has a built-in sound system, with an audio input performers can use.
There’s valet parking, parking in the alley and street parking.
The hotel staff are warm and available.
Apple Blossom caters events at the hotel, and the food is great.
Noise considerations at the hotel start at 10pm, and we’ll plan the music around them.
The folding glass doors let an event on the rooftop move between indoors and outdoors with the weather.

props.html: Questions to ask the Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver events team

items.html: Which spaces have an end time for amplified music, and when is it?
Does the hotel’s AV team need to connect or run the band’s sound, and is there a fee for that?
Where do vendors load in, and when can the band set up?
Is there power near where the band will play?
What wording do you need on the certificate of insurance?

props.html: Forward this list to the events team, or send us the answers and we’ll plan around them.
Questions about music at Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver

items.q: Can we bring our own band to an event at Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver?
items.a: Hotels like Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver generally let you book your own entertainment, within their rules on insurance, load-in and sound. Your event manager can confirm them for your date, and we send a certificate of insurance with every booking.

items.q: Does the band need the hotel’s AV team?
items.a: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel’s AV team can add anything beyond that, and we’ll work out the details with your event manager.

items.q: Can one act play the ceremony, the cocktail hour and the reception?
items.a: Yes. The same act can move with you from Apple Blossom’s terrace to The Colorado Ballroom, and one booking covers all of it.

items.q: How much does live music add to an event at Hyatt Centric Downtown Denver?
items.a: It depends on the size of the act and how much of the day it covers. Our pricing page has what live music costs in the Colorado market, and we’ll send a quote for your date.
